title: What you can do at the end of A1

sections.title: Your Hungarian so far
sections.content: You can already do a lot. One example for six areas you have worked on:

sections.title: A1 in one table
rows: Szeretek úszni, és a zene érdekel.
Jól beszélek angolul, egy kicsit magyarul.
A kutya a pad alatt van. Ebéd után pihenek.

sections.title: Putting it together
sections.content: A short plan uses many of these: *Szombaton Annával a park felé sétálok. Ebéd után a kapu előtt találkozunk.* Look at each piece: *-n* on the day, *-val* with a person, a postposition after a bare noun.

items.spanish: Szombaton Annával a park felé sétálok.
items.english: On Saturday I walk towards the park with Anna.

items.spanish: Ebéd után a kapu előtt találkozunk.
items.english: After lunch we meet in front of the gate.
I go to the museum by bus.

sections.content: When you are stuck, build a sentence from small pieces you know: who, what, where, when. Each piece has its own ending or its own word.
